landing.title: Make Vocabulary Teaching
landing.description: Voco is a desktop application designed for teachers to easily manage vocabulary packages and run classroom random-pick challenges, making teaching more efficient and engaging.

vocabManagement.title: Vocabulary Management
vocabManagement.description: Easily create and manage vocabulary packages with Excel import support and multi-language capabilities.

classroomChallenge.title: Classroom Challenge
classroomChallenge.description: Interactive vocabulary challenges with random picking to make classes more lively and engaging.

randomPicker.title: Random Picker
randomPicker.description: Universal random picker tool suitable for various classroom interaction scenarios.

cta.title: Ready to Get Started?
cta.description: Download Voco and make your classroom more lively and fun. Available for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

downloads.title: Download Voco
downloads.description: Choose the version suitable for your platform and start making vocabulary teaching more engaging
downloads.selectVersion: Select the version suitable for your system
downloads.windowsArmNotice: Windows on ARM is not yet supported. Please use the x86-64 version with emulation.

linuxExperimental.title: Experimental Support
linuxExperimental.description: Linux builds are not fully tested and may require additional system dependencies to run.

about.title: About Voco
about.description: Voco is an open-source project developed by NEXORA Studios, dedicated to providing educators with simple and efficient classroom tools. We believe technology should make teaching easier, not more complicated.

highlights.title: Why Choose Voco
highlights.subtitle: We focus on building truly useful tools

efficient.title: Efficient & Convenient
efficient.description: Clean and intuitive interface design, easy to use without complex learning.

multilingual.title: Multi-language Support
multilingual.description: Support for multiple language interfaces to meet the needs of teachers in different regions.

free.title: Completely Free
free.description: Open source and free, no ads, no in-app purchases, available to every teacher.

team.title: Our Team
team.subtitle: Composed of developers passionate about education

development.title: Development Team
development.description: Professional developers from NEXORA Studios, focused on creating high-quality software products.

community.title: Community Contributions
